scope: All authored deliverables, registers, audit records and scripts in this directory; private raw third-party caches and transferred input archives excluded intentionally.

recursive_container_exclusions.manifest.json: Does not inventory itself or SHA256SUMS or delivery containers
recursive_container_exclusions.SHA256SUMS: Hashes all other authored files including manifest; excludes itself and delivery containers to avoid recursion
recursive_container_exclusions.F4-COMPLETE-RESEARCH-PACKAGE.txt: Contains complete inventory and every other public package member, including manifest and SHA256SUMS; cannot contain itself or its gzip transport copy
recursive_container_exclusions.F4-COMPLETE-RESEARCH-PACKAGE.txt.gz: Exact deterministic gzip transport of the complete UTF-8 bundle; excluded from its own payload to avoid recursion; transport/plain hashes printed separately at delivery
